class_id: a documents row is admitted NOT_EXTRACTABLE, its type later joins the extractable list, and nothing re-admits it or ever revisits it
symptom: any documents row, on any IPO status/segment/slot, whose extraction_status was set to NOT_EXTRACTABLE while its type had no extractor, when that type is LATER added to AUTO_PERSIST_DOC_TYPES. The admission-time stamp is correct for the day it was written but becomes stale the moment the extractable list changes, and nothing flips it: selectPendingFilings would in fact pick the row up if the document cycle ever re-examined it (NOT_EXTRACTABLE does not trip documentExtractionBlocked's MANUAL_REVIEW/FAILED/IN_PROGRESS gates), but loadCandidateIpos only visits an IPO within its live window (isInLiveWindow) or on WITHDRAWN/POSTPONED — a closed or long-listed IPO whose only outstanding document was this row is simply never visited again, so the stale status is never noticed.
